description: Changes an already shown plan without showing it again: replace a material or tool, set brand/price/link/quantity, add or remove a line, add a stage or items to a stage, rename. The open plan updates itself within seconds; a saved plan (save_plan) is updated too. view_id comes from the show_renovation_plan response.

add.description: Add a new line / stage / task

key.description: Material key, exact tool name or key of a new stage

name.description: Current name of the line or task (for lookup), or the name of a new one

set.description: New fields: name, brand, qty, unit, price_min, price_max, store, url, rent, tier (change only this tier), labor_min, labor_max, wait…

stage.description: Stage key or name (for material/tool/task — where to look for the line)

name: update_plan_items
title: Update plan items
